content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to request a couple of adjustments before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause about intellectual property, it transfers rights upon delivery before payment is secured, which leaves payment unsecured; I propose modifying this so that rights transfer only upon receipt of full payment. - Regarding the relevant clause on termination, it permits ending the contract instantly without notice or compensation; I propose modifying this to require 20 days written notice and compensation for all services performed up to the effective date. Best regards
